task: Extend MetricDelta and agent metrics processors to capture per-turn token usage, then add backend-agreed token fields to the live /v1/metrics payload for anthropic-subscription sessions without ever computing cost client-side.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 5+ distinct subsystems: the core MetricDelta type (src/agents/core/metrics/types.ts), the claude.metrics-processor.ts agent-plugin processor, the SSO provider's metrics transport layer (metrics-types.ts, metrics-api-client.ts, metrics-aggregator.ts, metrics-sync-processor.ts), the CLI hook layer (hook.ts:sendSessionEndMetrics, which needs a new delta-read path built from scratch), and the desktop telemetry runtime (DesktopTelemetryRuntime.ts, a second independent caller of MetricsSender.sendSessionEnd). MetricDelta and the SessionLifecycleAttributes/ToolUsageAttributes types are shared contracts spanning every agent plugin and provider, matching the XXL 'shared contracts / architectural boundaries' criterion directly.

The task assumes 'backend-agreed token fields' already exist, but the technical analysis confirms no such field-name agreement is discoverable anywhere in this repository (no guide, ADR, or ticket reference) — the exact wire-field names (e.g. input_tokens/output_tokens vs prompt_tokens/completion_tokens) must come from an external source before implementation can safely proceed, since an unagreed or wrongly-shaped field is silently dropped by the backend with no client error.

Backend documented behavior: unrecognized or dict-shaped payload fields are silently dropped (the existing tool_counts: never ban is the precedent) — an incorrectly named or shaped token field causes undetectable metric loss in production, not a visible failure. Compounding this: the Anthropic usage object is read as untyped any today and has never had its exact field names verified against a live transcript; MetricsApiClient, SessionLifecycleAttributes/ToolUsageAttributes, buildSessionAttributes, and the claude.metrics-processor.ts usage path all show zero existing test coverage; and a second independent caller (DesktopTelemetryRuntime.sendSessionEndMetric) is affected by any signature change to sendSessionEnd.

At least 8 files touched across 5 directories: src/agents/core/metrics/types.ts, src/agents/plugins/claude/session/processors/claude.metrics-processor.ts, src/providers/plugins/sso/session/processors/metrics/{metrics-types.ts, metrics-api-client.ts, metrics-aggregator.ts, metrics-sync-processor.ts}, src/cli/commands/hook.ts, and src/telemetry/runtime/DesktopTelemetryRuntime.ts. The technical analysis explicitly flags that the task's named 4-file surface understates the real surface once hook.ts's missing delta-read path and metrics-aggregator.ts's missing token-accumulation logic are accounted for.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6): MetricDelta and the SessionLifecycleAttributes/ToolUsageAttributes payload types are shared contracts consumed by every agent plugin and provider (touches core shared utilities); the change also spans multiple workflows (session-end sync, periodic tool-usage sync) and two independent callers of MetricsSender.sendSessionEnd.

Requirements Clarity bumped from M (3) to L (4): backend-agreed token field names are undiscoverable in-repo and must be confirmed via the ticket/spec or a backend-team conversation before implementation; an unagreed field name is silently dropped by the backend with no client-side error.
